methods: Exact normalized stems plus lexical nearest-neighbor screening (three candidates per audited item), individual content review and question-level decision-task differentiation.
limitations: Word counts and lexical screens are quality checks, not empirical item difficulty, discrimination, reliability, DIF or proof of item independence. No candidate-response dataset was analyzed. Shared competencies are intentional; no claim that every conceivable cue or related topic has been eliminated.
